instruction: Please act as a professional Verilog designer. Implement a pipelined module that finds the second largest number from a list of 8-bit numbers. The module should have eight 8-bit inputs and one 8-bit output. The inputs can be assumed to be unique. The module should use a sorting algorithm that has a worst-case time complexity of O(n log n). Use pipeline structure to achieve this functionality.
